chosen.title: woman turning off her alarm clock
chosen.faces: none - only a hand and forearm enter frame; sleeper stays a blurred shape in the background
chosen.why: Digital clock reading 7:00 on a nightstand, natural window light, warm bedroom tone. A hand enters from the right at 2.2s and lands on the clock's top button at 2.6-2.8s, so the 0.7s cut (2.6-3.3) shows the fingers touching down and pressing. Reads instantly as 'morning alarm being switched off' with no face and no readable text; 16:9 1080p.

alternates.why: Silver twin-bell clock on a white nightstand, hand reaches in at 2.5s and presses the top button at 2.9-4.0s. Clean, no text, but only 720p and a soft-focus face lies in the background.
1080p black analog clock, hand grabs it at 1.5-3.5s with a nice reach. Downgraded because a book under the clock shows readable text ('New Scandinavian Design') and a blurred face is visible behind.

notes: Sheets tried: alarm clock, turning off alarm, waking up alarm, morning alarm hand, snooze (0 results), phone alarm bed. Downloaded 42897, 50753, 14850, 4758. 4758 rejected: pastel, over-styled prop look (blue floral clock, pink cup) and the hand only clips the top of frame for ~0.5s, face peeks in at 5.5s. Chosen clip caveats: a small out-of-focus brand label sits above the digital display (not legible at 1080p), and the red nail polish is a saturated accent that the planned desaturation grade will tame.
